title: Deco Rocks
description: This mod adds 5 new stone types, with a total of over 100 decorative blocks, along with new structures and ore generation
body:
This mod adds 5 new sets of stone blocks that can be mined in survival. They expand the existing block palette, bringing new building and creative possibilities to the game. It also features block-related structures that you can find and explore.
## new block sets:

- **Ironstone** - common stone in the mod. Besides its decorative use, it can be smelted into an iron nugget.
- **Eclogite** - can be found in deepslate mines.
- **Nephrite** - Can only be found in cherry groves and jungles
- **Mylonite** - a rock that only generates in the transition layer between regular stone and deepslate.
- **Soapstone** - a soft rock commonly found at sea level.


## New Structures

- **Ironstone ruins** - can be commonly found in plains, deserts, and savannas.
- **Eclogite ruins** -  can be found in cold, snowy biomes.
- **Nephrite ruins** - can be found in jungles and cherry groves.
